name: Jougasaki Ayaka
source:
Committee Chairman of [url=/c64498]Ouro's[/url] class. Her father is the president of a certain TV station and is now considered "new rich." She's mild-mannered, but can be immensely sadistic and abrasive. Ayaka looks down on commoners and wishes they, especially Ouro and [url=/c64303]Reina[/url], would leave Noble Academy.

Unfortunately for Ouro, he's a complete sucker for Ayaka's long, black hair and can't stand up to her. If anyone comments on her large rear end, she will instantly lose her temper.

"Oh dear. The whole class has become quite vulgar ever since this commoner arrived."

[From [url=http://kinkoi.nekonyansoft.com/chara07.html]NekoNyan[/url]]
